summary: Maritime attacks near the Strait of Hormuz have reached record levels, with 12 vessels struck within a single week according to BBC analysis. The surge in attacks is coinciding with slowed oil export activity in the region.
content: BBC Verify analysis of data from a UK maritime agency shows 12 vessels were struck in a week.

zh.title: 荷尔木兹海峡附近船舶袭击报告达到创纪录高位，石油出口放缓
zh.summary: 根据英国广播公司分析，霍尔木兹海峡附近的海上袭击达到创纪录水平，一周内有12艘船只遭到袭击。袭击次数的激增与该地区石油出口活动放缓相吻合。

title: The IPO drought is driving private equity-owned companies to the debt market to pay investors
summary: Private equity firms are increasingly using debt-funded dividend recapitalizations to distribute cash to investors as exit opportunities decline. The shift reflects a prolonged slowdown in initial public offerings limiting traditional exit channels.
content: Private equity firms are increasingly using debt-funded dividend recaps to return cash to investors as exits remain subdued.

zh.title: IPO融资困难促使私募股权公司向债券市场融资支付投资者
zh.summary: 随着退出机会减少，私募股权公司越来越多地使用债务融资的股息资本重组向投资者分配现金。这一转变反映了首次公开募股长期放缓，限制了传统退出渠道。

title: S&P 500 futures are little changed as index heads for losing week: Live updates
summary: Major U.S. stock indices are trading flat as markets approach the end of a losing week, despite gains on Thursday. The momentum shift signals investor uncertainty and profit-taking concerns heading into the weekend.
content: The three major averages are coming off of a winning session on Thursday.

zh.title: 标普500指数期货小幅波动，指数走向下跌周：实时更新
zh.summary: 美国主要股票指数交投平稳，尽管周四有所上涨，但市场接近下跌周的尾声。动能转变表明投资者不确定性和获利回吐担忧在周末前加剧。

title: Tesla finally delivers on its promise to create a flying car
summary: Tesla demonstrated a levitating Roadster sports car, showcasing technological capability despite acknowledged lack of commercial viability. The demonstration serves as a public statement of engineering prowess in the competitive automotive industry.
content: Tesla’s demonstration of a levitating Roadster sports car was “an engineering flex with no commercial value beyond embarrassing traditional car makers.”

zh.title: 特斯拉终于兑现承诺推出飞行汽车
zh.summary: 特斯拉展示了一辆悬浮Roadster跑车，展示了技术能力，尽管承认商业可行性不足。该演示是对竞争激烈的汽车行业工程实力的公开声明。

title: Russia returns to G20 table in Bangkok on U.S. invitation that angers Europe
summary: Russia rejoined G20 discussions in Bangkok following a U.S. invitation, creating diplomatic friction with European allies. The move raises questions about balancing U.S.-Russia engagement against Western unity on geopolitical issues.
content: Russia’s return to the G20 table has tested how far Washington’s outreach to Moscow will strain ties with European allies.

zh.title: 俄罗斯应美国邀请重返曼谷G20谈判桌，激怒欧洲
zh.summary: 俄罗斯应美国邀请重新加入曼谷G20讨论，与欧洲盟国造成外交摩擦。该举动引发了关于平衡美俄接触与西方地缘政治团结的问题。

title: Order to limit Starshield for Ukraine came from inside White House: Reuters reports
summary: The White House reportedly ordered restrictions on Starshield service for Ukraine, impacting critical drone operations and escalating tensions between Washington and Kyiv. The directive signals potential shifts in U.S. policy regarding military aid to Ukraine.
content: Officials say the White House ordered temporary limits on Ukraine’s Starshield service, affecting drone operations amid rising U.S.-Kyiv tensions.

zh.title: 白宫下令限制星盾对乌克兰的服务：路透社报道
zh.summary: 白宫据报下令限制星盾对乌克兰的服务，影响了关键的无人机作战，加剧了华盛顿和基辅之间的紧张关系。该指令预示了美国对乌克兰军事援助政策的潜在转变。

title: India's rupee forecast to weaken toward 100-per-dollar level even as RBI pushes back
summary: India's rupee is forecast to weaken to 100 per dollar despite Reserve Bank intervention that recently strengthened the currency from 96.79 levels. The projection reflects ongoing capital outflow pressures affecting emerging market currencies.
content: The RBI's latest moves have helped the rupee recover from 96.79 rupees per dollar to the 95-level over recent days.

zh.title: 尽管印度央行力挽狂澜，印度卢比仍预期走弱至每美元100卢比水平
zh.summary: 尽管印度储备银行近期的干预措施已将卢比从96.79水平升值，但印度卢比仍预期走弱至每美元100卢比。这一预测反映了影响新兴市场货币的持续资本外流压力。

title: Gasping for clean air: Singapore battles relentless haze as Prime Minister Wong warns of action
summary: Singapore faces severe air pollution from persistent haze disrupting businesses and daily life, prompting government intervention and protective measures. The environmental crisis highlights regional challenges affecting economic activity and public health.
content: Singapore continues to grapple with severe haze that is disrupting daily life and businesses, as authorities roll out protective measures — and issue warnings.

zh.title: 渴望清洁空气：新加坡对抗持续雾霾，总理黄循财警告将采取行动
zh.summary: 新加坡面临持续雾霾造成的严重空气污染，扰乱了商业和日常生活，促使政府进行干预和采取保护措施。这一环境危机凸显了影响经济活动和公共卫生的区域性挑战。
